high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article from technologyreview.com, dated February 5, 2024, by Rhiannon Williams. The headline reads, "A chatbot helped more people access mental-health services," with a subheading stating that the Limbic chatbot, which screens people seeking help for mental health problems, led to a significant increase in referrals among minority communities in England.
